violence.summary: Frequent fantasy action is mostly bloodless but includes beatings, impalements, drownings, blaster fire, monster attacks, crushing peril, and trident combat.

language.summary: Language is rare but includes mild-to-moderate profanity and crude insults.

romance.summary: Adults kiss, and Aquaman is shirtless for a substantial early stretch.

drinking.summary: Adults drink beer in a bar, one character gets drunk, and wine bottles are used as weapons.

entries.title: Avengers: Infinity War

violence.summary: Large-scale MCU combat includes torture, brutal beatings, impalings, crushings, scary villains, implied genocide, a child survivor flashback, and upsetting deaths of major characters.

language.summary: Language is not constant but includes several moderate profanities, crude insults, and two partial or implied F-word moments.

romance.summary: There are loving kisses, flirting, talk of love, and one scene that implies sex without showing anything explicit.

drinking.summary: CSM does not surface a meaningful drinking, drug, or smoking concern.

handoffNotes: Emotional impact is central: CSM flags final-seeming deaths, genocide-scale stakes, and a child losing her community.

violence.summary: Constant animated battles use explosions, swords, spears, knives, muskets, cannons, fire, spikes, robots, and hand-to-hand combat, with characters wounded and defeated.

language.summary: A few mild swear words and insults appear.

romance.summary: Some female characters wear revealing outfits, and brief innuendo appears.

drinking.summary: A brief sake-pouring moment is noted.

entries.title: Black Panther

violence.summary: Intense close-up fighting and larger battles include bloody wounds, stabbings, cold-blooded shootings, dead bodies, a destructive chase, war animals, super-weapons, and emotionally charged deaths.

language.summary: Infrequent profanity appears alongside a rude gesture and race- or power-related insults used in context.

romance.summary: A couple of kisses, flirtation, affectionate language, and one crotch-area smuggling gag are noted.

drinking.summary: Adults drink in the background of a casino scene, one character orders whiskey, and a fictional ritual herb is used mystically.

handoffNotes: Some deaths are specifically described as emotionally significant and may need prose context.

entries.title: Teen Titans Go! To the Movies

violence.summary: Frequent cartoon action uses guns, missiles, swords, lasers, chains, robots, explosions, backfiring weapons, comic injuries, and danger played mostly for jokes.

language.summary: There is no actual swearing, but the movie uses many insults plus frequent toilet humor.

romance.summary: A prank-call kissing joke appears, along with brief animated rear nudity and shirtless Robin.

drinking.summary: CSM does not surface a meaningful drinking, drug, or smoking concern.

violence.summary: Intense fantasy violence includes stabbings, slicing, shootings, head-biting, deaths on and off screen, crashes, explosions, possession imagery, scary symbiote bodies, and gooey remains.

language.summary: Several stronger profanities appear, including one F-word, crude terms, and repeated S-word variants.

romance.summary: A couple kisses while undressing, sex is implied by bed scenes, and no explicit nudity is described.

drinking.summary: The main character drinks whiskey and beer, wine appears at dinner, and cigarette smoking is noted.

entries.title: Avengers: Endgame

violence.summary: Frequent intense action includes deaths, severe injuries, dismemberment, decapitation, stabbing, crushing, shooting, impalement, choking, monsters, explosions, vigilante killings, and self-sacrifice.

language.summary: Occasional strong language includes moderate profanity, insults, religious exclamations, and some rude terms.

romance.summary: Romance is limited to brief kisses and embraces between couples, plus shirtless Thor.

drinking.summary: Thor drinks heavily as self-medication, with beer, ale, liquor, wine, bottles, and barrels shown before he changes course.

handoffNotes: Mourning, sadness, and deaths or non-return of beloved characters may need prose treatment.

violence.summary: Animated mayhem includes deaths of featured characters, explosions, brutal fights, gunfire, a decapitation, a bullet-riddled body, grenades, electrocution, falls, and child peril.

language.summary: Profanity includes moderate and stronger terms, crude insults, and occasional sexual references.

romance.summary: Batman and Catwoman begin an intimate relationship with multiple kisses, waking in bed together, cohabitation, and some revealing clothing.

drinking.summary: Characters drink socially.

violence.summary: Fantasy and space action includes guns, photon blasts, fistfights, wall impacts, explosions, alien deaths, minimal alien blood, and a scary-looking creature twist.

language.summary: Language includes S-word variants, mild profanity, a religious exclamation, and one joke using cockpit wording suggestively.

romance.summary: CSM does not surface a meaningful sex, romance, or nudity concern.

drinking.summary: One bar scene has brand signage, but CSM notes no visible drinks.

entries.title: Dark Phoenix

violence.summary: Heavy superhero action includes explosions, superpower battles, impalement, instant alien killings, a bloody main-character death, possible death, and an early parent death played sadly.

language.summary: Occasional profanity includes an F-word, an S-word, and religious exclamations.

romance.summary: Established couples flirt, kiss passionately, hug, and appear to live together.

drinking.summary: Characters drink at a party and dinner, Jean has several drinks, and Charles pours whiskey during a sad moment.

handoffNotes: Emotional prose may be needed for the sad parent death and main-character death.

language.summary: Occasional swearing includes mild-to-moderate profanity.

romance.summary: A character runs naked through the streets, though only upper-body or back views are shown.

drinking.summary: A future character needs and searches for medication.

violence.summary: Lengthy animated violence includes explosions, assault-weapon fire, alien attacks, electrocution, brutal hand-to-hand combat, chokes, beatings, apparent deaths, and danger to heroes and civilians.

language.summary: Only a few mild-to-moderate profanities are noted.

romance.summary: There is kissing, seductive behavior used to get information, and brief references to sleeping around and abstaining from sex.

entries.title: Shazam!

romance.summary: Comic strip-club visits and light innuendo appear, including jokes about breasts and nipples.

drinking.summary: A teen superhero and friend buy beer, taste it, reject it immediately, and switch to nonalcoholic drinks and snacks.

handoffNotes: Child abandonment, bullying of a disabled teen, and frightening monster deaths may need prose context despite the comedic tone.

language.summary: A few curse words and harsh phrases appear.

romance.summary: There is one kiss, and some costuming emphasizes curves and cleavage.

drinking.summary: CSM does not surface a meaningful drinking, drug, or smoking concern.

language.summary: Infrequent profanity includes S-word, B-word, religious exclamation, and mild terms.

romance.summary: Superman makes unwanted sexual advances that Wonder Woman rejects, and Lois describes her sex life with Lex.

drinking.summary: Lois smokes cigarettes and is shown struggling to quit after Superman criticizes the habit.

handoffNotes: CSM labels Violence & Scariness as 'some' while details include suicide, political killing, weapons fire, and gulag trauma.

language.summary: Language includes moderate profanity and a racist provocation from a bully.

romance.summary: Teen same-sex and opposite-sex romances include kissing, shirtless swimming, shower views of bare backs and shoulders, and one sexualized insult.
